text: Implemented structural hypothesis compilation and identity-bound inference slice: StructuralTContrast/StructuralFContrast resolve selectors through StructuralColumnOrigin, emit typed errors (unknown factor/level/basis, empty/duplicate/invalid weights, non-estimability), retain HypothesisMetadata with fingerprint/ColumnIds/weights/source/estimability evidence, and track effective F numerator rank. Compiled hypotheses validate result coefficient axes before evaluation; legacy TContrast/FContrast are explicitly documented compatibility-only. JVM+JS StructuralHypothesisSuite now proves semantic label/order invariance, wrong-fingerprint rejection, typed unknown/invalid cases, and rank-deficient geometry; focused suites passed 6/6 on both platforms.
